pages.text: Six things, in order. Each has a chapter; this is the short version.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Read this book.$() Chapters on the left; blue text links. Start with $(l:patchouli:start/spawn)Where You Woke Up$().$(li)$(bold)Make a fire.$() Three sticks on a diagonal make a $(l:patchouli:land/warmth)fire drill$(); hold right-click on a block. Cold is real.

$(li)$(bold)Find metal.$() Ore is regional. Look for small rock clusters on the ground and tap there with a flint hammer ($(l:patchouli:ore/prospecting)Prospecting$()).$(li)$(bold)Take a bounty.$() The boards in the capital's pavilions pay emeralds, and emeralds buy almost anything from the capital's people ($(l:patchouli:towns/caravans)Bounties$()).

$(li)$(bold)Claim your land$() once you settle: $(bold)J$() ($(l:patchouli:rules/claims)Claiming Land$()).$(li)$(bold)Fight a boss for technology.$() Machines are locked behind Blueprints that bosses drop ($(l:patchouli:tech/how_blueprints_work)Blueprints$()).$(br2)Lost? The last chapter, $(l:patchouli:faq/cold)Why Can't I...$(), answers the usual questions.
